entries: {@i Choose A or B:} (A) {@item Leather Armor|XPHB}, {@item Staff|XPHB|Arcane Focus (Staff)}, {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, {@item Scholar's Pack|XPHB}, and 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

classFeature.name: Combat Supporter
entries: Once per turn when you cast a level 1+ Healer spell that targets an ally, that ally gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of its spells and other abilities until the start of your next turn. If the spell targets multiple allies, you choose which one gains this benefit.
This bonus increases to +2 when you reach level 11, and to +3 when you reach level 17 as a Healer.

entries.name: Rules Clarification: Am I My Own Ally?
entries: For the purposes of this class' features, you do not count as your own ally, unless specified otherwise. The Healer is designed to be a support-oriented character, putting their allies ahead of themself.

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: Your studies into the magic of vitality allow you to cast spells. The information below details how you use the rules of Spellcasting with Healer spells, which appear in the Healer spell list later in this class's description.

entries.name: Cantrips
entries: You know two cantrips of your choice from the Healer spell list. {@spell Buff|HealerClass24} and {@spell Guidance|XPHB} are recommended.
Whenever you gain a Healer level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Healer spell list.
When you reach Healer levels 4 and 10, you learn another cantrip of your choice from the Healer spell list, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Healer Features table.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Healer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose four level 1 Healer spells. {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Jump|XPHB}, {@spell Heroism|XPHB} and {@spell Shield|XPHB} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Healer levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Healer Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Healer spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Healer Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 3 Healer, your list of prepared spells can include six Healer spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

If another Healer feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Healer spells for you.

entries.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace one spell on your list with another Healer spell for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Healer spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Healer spells.

classFeature.name: Expert Physician
entries: Select one of the following skills: {@skill Medicine|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, {@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}. You gain a bonus to ability checks you make with the chosen skill equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum bonus +1).

classFeature.name: Life Tether
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can create a magical tether of life energy which extends from your space and attaches to one ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The tether is severed if you end it (no action required), if you use this feature to attach a tether to a different creature, or if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The tether is also severed if you are ever more than 60 feet away from the target or if you are separated by {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}. Your Life Tether has the following properties.

entries.name: Healer's Dice
entries: You have a pool of four d8s, called your Healer's Dice. You can only expend one of these dice at a time unless a feature specifies otherwise, and you regain all expended dice when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The number of Healer's Dice you have and the maximum number that you can expend at once both increase as you gain levels in this class, as shown in the Healer's Dice & Max Uses columns of the Healer Features table.

entries.name: Healing Tether
entries: When you attach the tether to a creature, or as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while it is attached, you can expend and roll a number of your Healer's Dice and restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to the tethered creature equal to the total rolled.
Alternatively, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to heal yourself in this way, even if the tether isn't attached.

entries.name: Healer's Protection
entries: When the tethered creature makes a saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend one Healer's Die and grant it {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that roll.

entries.name: Life's Embrace
entries: You can target the tethered creature with your Healer spells as if it was within 5 feet of you, including spells with a {@filter range of 'Touch'|spells|class=healer (hc'24)|range=touch}.

classFeature.name: Healer Subclass
entries: You gain a Healer subclass of your choice. Subclasses are detailed after this class' description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you special abilities at certain Healer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass' features that are of your Healer level or lower.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Master Healer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dice Restoration
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you regain a number of expended Healer's Dice equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one die).
In addition, you can expend a spell slot to regain a number of expended Healer's Dice equal to twice the level of the spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Extra Healing
entries: Whenever you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to one or more creatures with a Healer spell, you can expend and roll a number of your Healer's Dice and add the result to the healing total.

entries.name: Vital Substition
entries: When you cast a {@filter Healer spell from the Abjuration or Necromancy school that has a Material component with a cost specified|spells|class=healer (hc'24)|components & miscellaneous=material with cost;!reprinted|school=a;n}, you can expend Healer's Dice to ignore that material component. You must expend one die for every 50 GP of the component's cost. You are not limited in the number of dice you can expend in this way.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Healer Subclass.

classFeature.name: Restoring Tether
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on a creature, instead of restoring {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to it you can expend two Healer's Dice to remove one of the following conditions from it: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB} or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.
Starting at level 13, you can expend three Healer's Dice to remove one of the following conditions instead: {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Empowering Tether
entries: The range of your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} increases to 90 feet.

In addition, while an ally is attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}, its attacks are empowered. Each time it hits with an attack, it can add {@dice 1d8} to the damage roll.

classFeature.name: Combat Supporter (+2)
entries: Your {@classFeature Combat Supporter|Healer|HealerClass24|1} bonus is +2.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Restoring Tether Improvement
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on a creature, instead of restoring {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to it you can expend three Healer's Dice to remove one of the following conditions instead: {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Healer Subclass.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Combat Supporter (+3)
entries: Your {@classFeature Combat Supporter|Healer|HealerClass24|1} bonus is +3.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Healer Subclass.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB} or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. {@feat Boon of Spell Recall|XPHB} is recommended.

classFeature.name: Multitether
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can temporarily increase the number of {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Life Tethers} you can maintain to an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 2 tethers). You can attach any number of these tethers to eligible creatures as part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Duration
entries: You can maintain multiple tethers in this way for 1 minute, or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. After this duration has elapsed, you can choose one tether to remain, if any still exist.

entries.name: Switching Targets
entries: If you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attach a tether to a new creature, you can do so with any number of tethers simultaneously.

entries.name: Shared Healing
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} or {@classFeature Restoring Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|7} features, each tethered creature gains the benefit at no additional Healer's Dice cost.
The same is true when you use your Healer's Protection {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, provided each creature is making a save against the same effect.

entries.name: Uses
entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore its use by expending a level 6+ spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Healer
entries: Healers study the magic of vitality, a power which they learn to manipulate with the ultimate altruistic intent - to preserve lives. Many Healers find occupations as physicians, combat medics, or researchers in medicine: healing the sick and the wounded using their powers for philanthropic or gainful employment. Some, however, find their talents best utilised by supporting others in a life of adventure.

For the life of an adventurer is inherently dangerous, constantly facing threats from nature, adversaries and the forces of evil, and greatly benefits from any available source of protection. While the role of the supporter is not the most glorious, Healers appreciate that it is often the most vital, for there is no glory in an avoidable death. Adventuring Healers excel at keeping their allies alive, treating their ailments, and augmenting their capabilities with their unique brand of magic.

entries.name: This is a Support Class
entries: Unlike other classes with elements that push characters toward a support role, the Healer is designed to solely occupy that role. It has no strictly offensive spells, and is not recommended for campaigns with only one player character.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Augmenter
entries: {@i Enhance the Capabilities of your Allies}

Healers who take the Vow of the Augmenter dedicate themselves to the study of life's potency. Dissatisfied with the limitations of their allies and themselves, they learn transformative magics which make their teammates stronger, faster and more effective at whatever role they claim. An adventurer never inhabits their full potential until they travel with one of these Healers.

subclassFeature.name: Augmenter Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Augmenter Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Augmenter Spells
rows: {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Buff|HealerClass24}, {@spell Enhance Ability|XPHB}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB}, {@spell Jump|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Enhancing Tether
entries: Whenever you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} feature, you can cast the {@spell Buff|HealerClass24} spell on that ally as part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Dual Augmentation
entries: When you take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast one of the spells from your {@subclassFeature Augmenter Spells|Healer|HealerClass24|Augmenter|HealerClass24|3} feature, you can cast a second Augmenter spell that you have prepared as part of the same action, but using a separate spell slot. Each spell can only target a single, separate ally, but both targets gain the benefits of your {@classFeature Combat Supporter|Healer|HealerClass24|1} feature.
You can simultaneously concentrate on both spells; if you need to roll to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}, you only roll once, and lose both spells on a failure.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Greater Empowerment
entries: The damage die for your {@classFeature Empowering Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|10} increases to a {@dice d12}. Furthermore, creatures attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on an attack roll with a {@dice d20} roll of one lower than normal.

subclassFeature.name: Master Augmenter
entries: When you target a creature with the {@spell Buff|HealerClass24} spell, it gains all three benefits at once, instead of you having to choose one.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Martyr
entries: {@i Exemplify Self Sacrifice}

Healers that take the Vow of the Martyr embody selflessness in its truest form. Through relentless study and practice, they wield powers to spare others from suffering, but at their own expense. The heroism of these Healers has inspired many great works of art, and continues to inspire acts of bravery on the battlefield.

subclassFeature.name: Martyr Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Martyr Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Martyr Spells
rows: {@spell Compelled Duel|XPHB}, {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB}, {@spell Warding Bond|XPHB}, {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB}
{@spell Circle of Power|XPHB}, {@spell Mass Cure Wounds|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Martyr's Endurance
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Healer level. Furthermore, your self-sacrificing nature improves your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} in the following ways.

entries.name: Endurance
entries: Whenever you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on an ally, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the amount rolled on the Healer's Dice (round up).

entries.name: Anguish
entries: Whenever a creature that is attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} takes damage, you can choose to reduce the damage it takes by half (round down), and take the other half of the damage yourself (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Exemplar
entries: When you take damage in place of another creature through the use of a feature like Anguish or a spell like {@spell Warding Bond|XPHB}, your act of selflessness can inspire an ally of your choice within 60 feet of yourself that can see you (no action required). Until the end of its next turn, the ally has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Selfless Sacrifice
entries: You can cast {@spell Heroic Sacrifice|HealerClass24} by expending 4 Healer's Dice instead of a spell slot.

If you cast {@spell Heroic Sacrifice|HealerClass24} on a creature attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the incurred saving throw. If you succeed on the save, the attached creature also gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} if it lacks it.

subclassFeature.name: True Martyrdom
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Martyr's Endurance|Healer|HealerClass24|Martyr|HealerClass24|3} feature improves, replacing the previous benefits.

entries.name: Endurance
entries: Whenever you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on an ally, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the amount rolled on the Healer's Dice, instead of half as much.

entries.name: Anguish
entries: Whenever a creature that is attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} takes damage, you can choose to reduce the damage they take by any amount (you choose when you use this feature), and then you take damage equal to half the amount you reduced (round down, no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Protector
entries: {@i Protect the Innocent, No Matter the Cost}

Healers who take the Vow of the Protector are honor-bound to protect their allies from danger in all forms that it takes. Their abjurative magic empowers their healing and conjures radiant barriers to shield their companions from every threat. Their companions rarely fall- and only after the world itself has tried.

subclassFeature.name: Protector Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Protector Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Protector Spells
rows: {@spell Aid|XPHB}, {@spell Prayer of Healing|XPHB}, {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB}, {@spell Shield|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Tether of Protection
entries: Whenever you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on a creature, it gains a bonus to its saving throws until the start of your next turn. The bonus is equal to one plus the number of Healer's Dice you spent.

subclassFeature.name: Shield of the Protector
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Free Casting
entries: You can cast the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Protective Shield
entries: When a creature attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} is hit by an attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cast {@spell Shield|XPHB}, granting the benefits of the spell to the target instead of yourself.

subclassFeature.name: Vigilant Protector
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of you is hit by an attack or makes a saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to attach your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} to it. You can use your {@subclassFeature Shield of the Protector|Healer|HealerClass24|Protector|HealerClass24|3||Protective Shield} or {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healer's Protection} as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Warding Essence
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can choose two damage types, two conditions, or one of each from the lists below. You and creatures attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage types, and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the chosen conditions until you use this feature again.

entries.name: Damage Types
entries: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.

entries.name: Conditions
entries: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Bountiful Healing
entries: When you use the Extra Healing benefit of your {@classFeature Master Healer|Healer|HealerClass24|5} feature, you can replace one or more of the Healer's Dice with a {@dice d6}, instead of expending them.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Life Tether
entries: Your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} improves.

entries.name: Total Protection
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Life Tether's} Healer's Protection {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can cause the ally to automatically succeed on the saving throw. If you are also making a saving throw against the same effect, you can also gain this benefit.
Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Expansive Ward
entries: You can now choose any damage type or condition for your {@subclassFeature Warding Essence|Healer|HealerClass24|Protector|HealerClass24|6} feature.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Siphon
entries: {@i Steal and Redistribute Foes' Vitality}

Healers who take the Vow of the Siphon see all living creatures as a bountiful source of energy, prime for reaping. Inspired by the medicinal and magical properties of leeches, they unearth dark powers which allow them to steal vitality from their enemies, leaving them weakened and vulnerable. While these dark practitioners are shunned from many Healer communities, their abilities prove indispensable to adventurers seeking to vanquish great foes.

subclassFeature.name: Siphon Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Siphon Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
In addition, Necromancy spells from the Wizard spell list are added to the Healer spell list for you.

entries.caption: Siphon Spells
rows: {@spell Bane|XPHB}, {@spell Blindness/Deafness|XPHB}, {@spell Hold Person|XPHB}, {@spell Inflict Wounds|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Harmful Tether
entries: You can attach your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} to foes, rather than allies, granting the following effects.

entries.name: Leeching Tether
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether}, you can deal an amount of Necrotic damage equal to the healing roll to the target instead of restoring {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to it.

entries.name: Sap Strength
entries: Whenever the target of your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} deals damage to another creature, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce that damage by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 damage reduced).
Starting at Healer level 10, you can use this feature without using your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Life Leech
entries: When you use your {@subclassFeature Harmful Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|Siphon|HealerClass24|3||Leeching Tether} you can restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to yourself or to one creature of your choice within 15 feet of the target. The amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} is equal to half the damage taken by the target (round up).

subclassFeature.name: Improved Sap Strength
entries: When you use your {@subclassFeature Harmful Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|Siphon|HealerClass24|3||Sap Strength}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to add half your Healer level (round up) to the amount of damage reduced.

subclassFeature.name: Sap Defenses
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can attempt to rob the defenses of one creature attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}. Choose one damage type. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it gains {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to the damage type you chose until the start of your next turn. This {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} bypasses {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}, but the target automatically succeeds on its save if it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}.
Once a creature fails its save against this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Leech Conduit
entries: You always have the {@spell Life Siphon|HealerClass24} spell prepared. While you are concentrating on {@spell Life Siphon|HealerClass24}, a creature attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} automatically fails its saves against the spell, and takes an additional {@dice 1d12} damage.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Apothecary
entries: {@i Heal with Potions, Tinctures and Balms}

Healers who take the Vow of the Apothecary learn ancient alchemical recipes to distil their life-saving magics into substances which can be stored and distributed. These practitioners value precision, and preparedness above all other virtues as they ready specialised tinctures to aid adventurers toward chemically-assisted success.

subclassFeature.name: Apothecary Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Apothecary Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Apothecary Spells
rows: {@spell Adrenaline Rush|HealerClass24}, {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Elemental Strikes|ArtExpansion}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Liquid Healing
entries: You are well trained in the formulation of potions that cure ailments.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}.

entries.name: Potion Brewing
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can expend a number of your Healer's Dice to create a number of special healing potions up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1). You must have {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB} or a {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB} on hand for the duration of the rest.
You spend Healer's Dice separately for each potion, which are stored within empty flasks. A potion can't store more Healer's Dice than your normal maximum.
When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can also create one potion in this way.

entries.name: Spoiling Potions
entries: Each potion created by this feature can only be drunk once, and any that remain spoil when you next finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, losing its potency.

entries.name: Drinking the Potion
entries: A creature holding one of these potions can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of it. The drinker regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to one roll of the Healer's Dice stored in the potion, plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 Hit Point restored).

entries.name: Potion of Curing
entries: Starting at Healer level 7, when you use this feature to create a potion, you can make it one that ends a condition on being drunk, instead of restoring {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. To do so, select one condition that you can cure with your {@classFeature Restoring Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|7} feature, and expend the number of Healer's Dice you would need to spend to cure it with that feature.

subclassFeature.name: Chemical Tether
entries: While a creature is attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}, if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from drinking a potion, it can re-roll any 1s or 2s on any dice rolled to determine how many {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} it regains, until they each roll a 3 or higher.

subclassFeature.name: Medicinal Master
entries: You and any creature attached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison and Necrotic damage.

In addition, whenever you cure a creature of a condition from the list below using a Healer feature (including the potions you create with this subclass) or a Healer spell, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the same condition for the next hour.

The conditions eligible for this feature are: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Spell-Imbued Potions
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can touch an empty flask and cast one of your Apothecary spells, expending a spell slot and any consumed Material components as normal. Instead of producing the effects of the spell immediately, they are stored within the flask as a special potion.
A creature can drink the potion as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, granting itself the benefits of the spell for its full duration without requiring {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
An unconsumed potion spoils when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, or if you create another one. If this happens, you can recover a consumed Material component from the flask.

subclassFeature.name: Panacea
entries: The potions you create with your {@subclassFeature Liquid Healing|Healer|HealerClass24|Apothecary|HealerExpansionPack24|3} feature improve, depending on whether it heals the target or ends a condition on it.

entries.name: Healing
entries: You add an extra {@dice d4} to the healing roll for each Healer's Die spent.

entries.name: Inoculation
entries: The drinker gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the removed condition for 1 hour.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Diplomat
entries: {@i Advocate Peace & Nonviolence}

Healers who take the Vow of the Diplomat believe that nearly any conflict can be resolved with words. In pursuit of this ideal, they utilise enchantment magic to bewitch their would-be foes into states of non-violence, making way for calm and reasonable discussion. These Healers are widely sought out on diplomatic missions, with skills to both keep the peace and argue for alliances.

subclassFeature.name: Diplomat Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Diplomat Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Diplomat Spells
rows: {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}, {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Dissuade Violence|HealerExpansionPack24}, {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Skilled Communicator
entries: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}. Regardless of your choice, whenever you make an ability check with one of these skills, you can use your Intelligence modifier in place of the normal one.

subclassFeature.name: Tether of Nonviolence
entries: Your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} feature improves, granting the following benefits.

entries.name: Peace Tether
entries: When you attach or move your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} on to an ally, you can attach a second tether to a different creature. This tether shares all the same properties as your Life Tether, but can't be attached to your allies: only your foes.

entries.name: Negate Violence
entries: Once per turn when the target of your Peace Tether rolls for damage, you can expend your Healer's Dice and roll them (no action required). Add 2 to the result for each die spent. The target must subtract the result from the damage roll, to a minimum of 0 damage. If you reduce the damage to 0, the target takes Psychic damage equal to the roll's result.

entries.name: Charmer
entries: The target of your Peace tether can't benefit from {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition if you are the charmer.

subclassFeature.name: Peacekeeper
entries: When you attach your Life and Peace Tethers, you can cause the targets to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against one another, and to have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects created by the other. This effect lasts until one of the targets is no longer attached to their tether, or until you end it (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Enchanter
entries: You have mastered magic to sway the minds of others. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magical Diplomat
entries: You can cast your Diplomat Spells without expending a spell slot by expending Healer's Dice instead. The amount of dice you need to spend is equal to twice the spell's level. You are not limited in the number of dice you can expend in this way.

entries.name: Swayed Inaction
entries: When you give a creature the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, you can also lull it into total inaction, giving it the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition as well. The condition ends when the creature loses the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, or if it takes any damage. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Inescapable Charm
entries: While a creature is attached to your Peace Tether, it can be {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you even if it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Resourceful Diplomat
entries: When you cast one of your Diplomat Spells by expending Healer's Dice, the number of dice you need to spend is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1 die.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Tactician
entries: {@i Lead Allies to Victory with Tactical Superiority}

Healers who take the Vow of the Tactician are constantly devising and scheming battle tactics, carefully considering the strengths, abilities and synergies of their allies, and ways they can use their magic to shape the battlefield. Given enough time to prepare, a team led by one of these Healers is unstoppable.

subclassFeature.name: Tactician Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Tactician Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Tactician Spells
rows: {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB}, {@spell Silence|XPHB}, {@spell Web|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Well Prepared
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Investigation|XPHB} or {@skill Religion|XPHB}. In addition, you gain a bonus to your Initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).

subclassFeature.name: Tactical Tether
entries: Your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} feature improves, granting the following benefits.

entries.name: All Part of the Plan
entries: The creature attached to the tether automatically succeeds on its saving throws against your Tactician spells.

entries.name: Reposition
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether} on an ally, you can command the ally to reposition. When you do, the target can immediately move up to 10 feet for each Healer's Die spent without provoking Opportunity Attacks, provided its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't 0. In addition, you can choose to grant it {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the healing roll, instead of restoring its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Plan to Execution
entries: You are constantly devising plans and stratagems for your party to execute in combat, and you can use your supportive magic to execute these plans with supernatural synchronicity.

entries.name: The Team
entries: Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can devise a plan for the creatures who participate in the rest with you. The creatures must be within 30 feet of you for the full duration of the rest, and the maximum number of creatures you can include is equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 creature). All creatures forget the plan when you next finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: The Plan
entries: For each creature involved, select one action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} that it can take to be its planned action.

If a planned action is the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, it can only involve one attack, and if it is the {@action Magic|XPHB} action, it can only be to cast a spell of level 2 spell or lower, or to activate a magic item. The spell is selected in advance.

entries.name: The Execution
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can execute the plan. Each creature involved that is within 60 feet of you can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and use its planned action. You decide the order in which the actions take place.

On a creature's next turn after taking this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, it is unable to use its action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} (whichever it took during the {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}).

entries.name: Uses
entries: Once you execute a plan, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Grandmaster
entries: You no longer allow obstacles to impede your tactical repositioning. When you use your Reposition feature, instead of the target moving, you can cause it to teleport the distance it would have moved to an unoccupied space you can see, even if its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0.

subclassFeature.name: Shifting Tactics
entries: Over the course of 1 minute, you can help one of your allies to re-prepare one of its features as if it had finished a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The ally must remain within 5 feet of you for the duration of this process.

For example, if the target can change which spells it has prepared through the Spellcasting feature when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it could change which spells it has prepared, or a target could change the weapons it has selected with the Weapon Mastery feature.
Once an ally benefits from this feature, it can't benefit from it again until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Perfected Plans
entries: When you use your {@subclassFeature Plan to Execution|Healer|HealerClass24|Tactician|HealerExpansionPack24|6} feature, a planned {@action Attack|XPHB} action is no longer limited in the number of attacks the creature can make, and a planned {@action Magic|XPHB} action can now be to cast a spell up to level 5.

subclassFeature.name: Vow of the Vile
entries: {@i Encourage Sinful Behaviour}

Healers who take the Vow of the Vile have typically spent significant time in the Hells, and have been thoroughly exposed to the darkest corners of peoples' souls. They encourage allies to give in to their sinful tendencies, granting dark powers in exchange for the delight of corrupting their good natures. While their practices are dark and taboo, adventuring parties often struggle to let go of these Healers. It's just fun to be bad sometimes.

subclassFeature.name: Infernal Spells
entries: When you reach a Healer level specified in the Infernal Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Infernal Spells
rows: {@spell Armor of Agathys|XPHB}, {@spell Finedd's Deception|HealerExpansionPack24}, {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB}, {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Infernal Knowledge
entries: You learn the {@language Infernal|XPHB} language. If you already know Infernal, you learn one other language of your choice. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks made to recall knowledge of the Nine Hells or one of the other lower planes.

subclassFeature.name: Sinful Tether
entries: You can provoke sinfulness within your allies. Select three Sins from the {@filter Sin Effects options|optionalfeatures|feature type=se}, listed later in this subclass. Whenever you attach your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} to one of your allies, you can grant it the benefit of one Sin until the tether is no longer attached to it.
Whenever you gain a Healer level, you can exchange one sin you know for another. You learn another Sin at Healer levels 6 (4 Sins), 10 (5 Sins), 14 (6 Sins) and 18 (7 Sins).

subclassFeature.name: Infernal Retribution
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether}, you can cause roiling flames to surround the target for 10 minutes. Note down the healing roll. If the target takes damage from a creature while the flames still surround it, the flames leap to that creature and deal Fire damage to it equal to the healing roll plus your Intelligence modifier. The flames then extinguish.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Deadly Sin
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can enhance one of the Sin effects you have acting on one of your allies. For the next 10 minutes, the target gains the Sin's Deadly Sin enhancement, and the Sin persists on the target, even if it becomes disconnected from your life Tether. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless you expend a level 6+ spell slot to use it again (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Bad Influence
entries: When you attach your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} to one of your allies, you can now grant it the benefits of two Sins, instead of one.

spell.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: You briefly fill one creature you can see within range with surging energy. Until the start of your next turn, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 20 feet, and each time it hits with an attack roll and deals damage, it can add {@dice 1d10} to the damage roll.

spell.name: Buff
entries: You briefly enhance the capabilities of one creature other than yourself that you can see within range. Select one of the following enhancements, which lasts until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Amplified Attacks
entries: The next time the target hits with an attack roll and deals damage, it can add {@dice 1d8} to the damage roll.

entries.name: Fleeting Protection
entries: The target gains {@dice 1d8} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. These {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} vanish if any remain when the spell ends.

entries.name: Speedy Flight
entries: The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet and {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} are made against it with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage of Amplified Attacks and the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} of Fleeting Protection increase by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}) and 17 ({@dice 4d8}). The {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} boost of Speedy Flight also increases by 5 feet when you reach levels 5 (10 feet), 11 (15 feet) and 17 (20 feet).

spell.name: Elemental Body
entries: You infuse one creature you can see within range with elemental energy, transforming its physical form into a living embodiment of that element. Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder, Radiant or Necrotic. The target gains the following benefits for the duration.

entries.name: Flight
entries: The target gains a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and can hover.

entries.name: Fluid Form
entries: The target can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can move through another creature's space and end its turn there. The first time the target enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes {@damage 3d8} damage of the type you chose.

entries.name: Immunities
entries: The target gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions, and to the damage type you chose.

entries.name: Infused Attacks
entries: Whenever the target hits with an attack roll, it can deal an extra {@damage 2d8} damage of the type you chose to the attack's target.

spell.name: Exoskeleton
entries: You cause one creature you can see within range to grow a magically protective exoskeletal carapace. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to every damage type except for Psychic, and it cannot be moved or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition against its will.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature per spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Greater Aid
entries: Choose up to four creatures within range. Each target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 50 for the duration. If a target is also benefiting from the {@spell Aid|XPHB} spell, that spell's effects are suppressed on the target until this spell ends on it.

spell.name: Greater Enhance Ability

components.m: A gilded tuft of fur or feather

entries: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} using the chosen ability.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5. You can choose a different ability for each target.

spell.name: Helping Hand

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range makes a D20 Test

entries: You embolden the triggering creature, which can roll {@dice 1d8} and add the result to the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}. You choose to cast this spell before the roll is made. If the roll is an attack roll, on a hit the attacker can also add the result of the {@dice d8} to the damage roll.

spell.name: Heroic Sacrifice

time.condition: which you take when you see another creature within range fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect

entries: You interpose yourself against the triggering magic, causing it to affect you instead of the original target. The triggering creature is no longer affected by the spell or magical effect, and you become its target, even if you would normally be out of its range. You immediately make the required saving throw against the effect, sufferring its consequences on a failure. You do not suffer any effects on a successful save.

spell.name: Instant Refreshement

m.text: A fine beverage worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a creature and flood it with healing energy, refreshing and rejuvinating its body and mind, causing it to instantly gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

spell.name: Jotunn Transformation

components.m: a piece of stone inscribed with a giant rune

entries: Select one creature you can see within range, which is infused with essence of a giant. The target gains the following benefits for the duration.

entries.name: Giant Size
entries: Its size increases to Huge, if it was not already larger. If there is no room for it to grow, the spell fails. The target's equipment grows with it. Attacks with {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} or a weapon enlarged in this manner deal an extra {@damage 1d12} damage.

entries.name: Giant's Strength
entries: Its Strength score increases to 11 plus twice the spell's level, if it was not already higher.

entries.name: Giant's Endurance
entries: It gains a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 10 times the spell's level.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the Giant's Strength and Giant's Endurance benefits. If cast with a level 7+ slot, the target becomes Gargantuan instead of Huge and the extra damage increases to {@dice 2d12}.

spell.name: Life Siphon
entries: Choose up to four willing creatures that you can see within range. For the duration, at the end of each of a recipient's turns, it can select one creature that it can see within 30 feet of it. The selected creature must make a Consitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes {@damage 4d12} Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice when you cast the spell) or half as much on a success. Success or failure, the recipient regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the amount of damage taken.
Once a creature takes this damage, it is immune to this spell's effects until the start of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Protection from Malady
entries: You ward one creature you can see within range against harmful effects. Select one of the following conditions: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the chosen condition for the duration. If the creature already has the condition when you cast this spell, the condition does not end, but the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any saving throw it makes to end that condition for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4. You can choose a different condition for each target.

spell.name: Synergize
entries: Select two to three willing creatures that you can see within range. For the duration, each target is linked, making it more aware of and capable of helping its fellow linked creatures. Linked creatures gain the following benefits.

items: Whenever a linked creature fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, another linked creature within 30 feet of it can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to allow it to re-roll the test. It must use the new result.

When a linked creature rolls damage for an attack, it can add {@dice 1d6} to the damage roll for each other linked creature within 30 feet of it, as those allies contribute to the strike. It can do so only once per turn.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Total Refreshment

m.text: A fine beverage worth 999+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You channel immense healing energy into a creature you touch, instantly revitalising it. The target gains the benefits of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

Completing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in this way does not restore expended level 7+ spell slots, nor uses of features which allow a creature to cast a level 7+ spell without a spell slot (e.g. Mystic Arcanum from the Warlock class). Furthermore, once a creature is affected by this spell, it can't be affected by it again until it naturally finishes {@dice 1d4} Long Rests.

spell.name: Unlock Potential
entries: You touch a creature other than yourself and unlock the latent potential within it. Select either Unlocked Spellcasting or Unlocked Attacks. The target gains the benefits for the duration.

entries.name: Unlocked Spellcasting
entries: When the target casts a spell using a spell slot, it can treat the spell as if it was cast with a spell slot of one level higher. Spells cast with a level 5+ spell slot aren't affected.

entries.name: Unlocked Attacks
entries: When the target takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, it can make one additional attack as part of that action. In addition, it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Force damage to the target whenever it hits with an attack roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can concentrate on the spell for longer: for 10 minutes (level 5-6 slot), for 1 hour (level 7 slot) or for 8 hours (level 8 slot). If you use a level 9 slot, the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and its duration becomes 24 hours.

spell.name: Accelerate Time

m.text: an hourglass filled with quicksilver, worth 300+ GP

entries: You touch a willing creature and it immediately experiences one minute of time's passage. The target ages one minute, and any effect it is under progress one minute, reducing its remaining duration and potentially ending the effect early if its duration is lapsed. Anything that would normally occur on the creature's turn that doesn't require it to act, such as making a saving throw, occurs in rapid succession.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The amount of time that passes for the target increases to one hour with a level 6-8 spell slot, and to 24 hours with a level 9 spell slot. The target cannot benefit from a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} from time passing in this way.

spell.name: Cleanroom
entries: All objects and surfaces within a 60 foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on yourself become immaculately clean, and free of any toxins or diseases they may have been carrying. The {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} does not extend beyond the room you are in.

spell.name: Dissuade Violence

time.condition: which you take when you are hit by an attack roll

entries: You inovke guilt into a creature that attacks you, causing it to pull its punches. The triggering attacker re-rolls the attack, and must use the new roll. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage from that creature's attacks until the end of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, if it still hits.

spell.name: Finedd's Deception

time.condition: which you take when you or one of your allies begins saying something you know to be a lie.

entries: You fill the triggering speaker's mind with knowledge of the nuance and semantics utilised by devils to tell misleading but technical truths. The lie spoken by the target twists into a sentence that is technically true, but still conveys the original meaning of the lie. The target gains a +10 bonus to any Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check it makes for telling the lie in this moment, and the lie holds up to the scrutiny of the {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB} spell.

spell.name: Fodir's Friendly Facade
entries: You craft an enchanting glamour for one ally that you can see within range, which makes it an unappealing target for its foes. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration, with the target as the charmer. A {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

spell.name: Ilnera's Gambit
entries: You shunt an ally through space, as if it were a piece on a game board, granting it an ideal opportunity to strike. Select one willing creature that you can see within range, other than yourself. That creature is teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within range. Immediately after teleporting, the creature can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a target of your choice; if this attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d10} Force damage.

spell.name: Invigorate
entries: You flood one willing creature you can see with surging vitality. The target regains {@dice 8d6} plus your spellcasting modifier {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and if it is restored to full {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it gains the remaining points as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. In addition, the first time the target hits with an attack on its next turn, it deals an extra {@damage 4d6} damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing and damage rolls increase by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 4.

spell.name: Rejuvinate
entries: You undergo a rigorous process of permanently reversing the ravages of time within one willing creature, who must remain within your reach for the full duration of the spell's casting, causing it to become younger. You determine the final age of the target, although you can't de-age it into pre-maturity.

The first time a creature is affected by this spell, it suffers no adverse effects. Each subsequent time, it must roll {@dice 1d20}. If it rolls the number of times it has been targeted by this spell or lower, it suffers total amnesia, which is permanent and irreversible, even by means of a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

spell.name: Reverse Wounds

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range takes damage.

entries: You manipulate the transfer of vitality within the damaged creature, undoing harm to it. The target immediately regains the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} it lost from the triggering damage.

spell.name: Strength of Jahdore
entries: You imbue one willing creature you can see within range with supernatural strength. Until the spell ends, the creature's Strength score increases to 21, unless it was already higher. In addition, whenever the affected creature hits with a melee attack roll, it can push the target 10 feet away from it, provided the target is no more than one size category larger than it.
This spell does not confer any additional uses of features based on the target's Strength score, if it has any.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The target's Strength score increases to 18 plus the spell slot's level, instead of 21.

optionalfeature.name: Envy
entries: The target becomes envious of others' success. Whenever it sees another creature within 30 feet of it roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls it makes against that creature until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: The target can trigger this effect whenever it sees another creature succeed on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, regardless of the rolled number. It can't do so again until the start of its next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Gluttony
entries: The target gains an insatiable desire to consume nourishing substances. Whenever it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from drinking a potion or rolling {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, it regains the maximum amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, instead of rolling.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: The target can trigger this effect with any source of healing, not just potions and {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Gluttony
entries: The target becomes covetous of the powers you grant it. Each time you cast a level 1+ spell on the target or heal it with your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2||Healing Tether}, it gains 1 Greed Point. Whenever the target rolls for a damage roll, an attack roll or a saving throw, it can choose to expend any number of Greed Points and add them to the roll. These points disappear when either of you start a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, or if the target is detached to your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: When the target expends Greed Points, it can retain one of the expended points. It also doesn't lose the points if it becomes detached from the {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2}, but it does lose them if the Deadly Sin ends without it attached.

optionalfeature.name: Lust
entries: The target becomes self-posessed and lecherous. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, and gains a +1 bonus to its Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: The target gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

optionalfeature.name: Pride
entries: The target becomes bold, self assured, and cocky. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, and gains a +1 bonus to its Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: The target gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

optionalfeature.name: Sloth
entries: The target begins to resent unnecessary movement. If the target ends its turn without having moved or spending any of its movement, it gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Healer level, which last until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: While the target has these {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage.

optionalfeature.name: Wrath
entries: The target becomes aggressive, with an insatiable urge to bring others to harm. Its attacks score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a {@dice d20} roll 1 lower than normal.

entries.name: Deadly Sin
entries: The target's attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d8} Force damage.

item.name: Bandages of Support
entries: These bandages are worn by wrapping them around the forearms, and they strengthen your connections to those you heal. While wearing them, the range of your {@classFeature Life Tether|Healer|HealerClass24|2} increases by 30 feet, and when an ally gains the benefits of your {@classFeature Combat Supporter|Healer|HealerClass24|1} feature, it retains the benefit for one additional round.

item.name: Mask of the Plague Doctor
entries: This mask covers the entire face, and features a long beak-like protrusion, which is filled with pleasant smelling substances.

While wearing the mask, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, and you automatically succeed on saves made to avoid being {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} by gases and airborne poisons and diseases, such as the {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB} spell.

item.name: Robe of the Pacifist
entries: This fine robe is adorned with symbols meaning 'Peace' from various cultures. When you don these robes for the first time on a day, you immediately gain the benefits of the {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB} spell (DC 15), which last until you doff the robes or until you take an action that would end the spell.

item.name: Roulette Potion
entries: When you drink this potion, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a roll of 1-5, you regain {@dice 2d8 + 3} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. On a 6, you take {@damage 2d8 + 3} Poison damage. The potion's red liquid contains anywhere between 1 and 6 bubbles, the number changing each time it is shaken.

item.name: Bandolier of Buffs
entries: This leather bandolier contains {@dice 1d6} enclosed glass capsules filled with mysterious differently colored liquids. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while wearing the bandolier, you can extract one of these capsules and throw it at a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The capsule shatters and target gains the benefits of a spell that's stored within that container, which last for the full duration of that spell. If the spell has multiple possible effects, the target chooses which one to be affected by.

When you find the bandolier, the DM randomly determines the contents of each capsule using the table below. A casting of {@spell Identify|XPHB} can reveal what spell is stored within one of the capsules.

item.name: +1 Asclepius Staff
entries: This fine {@item wooden staff|XPHB} is decorated with reliefs of snakes twisting along its shaft, which faintly glow when you heal a creature.
You can use the {@item staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and while you are holding it you gain a +1 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your Healer spells.
In addition, whenever you roll a number that is equal to this {@item staff|XPHB}'s +1 bonus or lower on a Healer's Die, you can re-roll the die and must use the new roll.

item.name: +2 Asclepius Staff
entries: This fine {@item wooden staff|XPHB} is decorated with reliefs of snakes twisting along its shaft, which faintly glow when you heal a creature.
You can use the {@item staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and while you are holding it you gain a +2 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your Healer spells.
In addition, whenever you roll a number that is equal to this {@item staff|XPHB}'s +2 bonus or lower on a Healer's Die, you can re-roll the die and must use the new roll.

item.name: +3 Asclepius Staff
entries: This fine {@item wooden staff|XPHB} is decorated with reliefs of snakes twisting along its shaft, which faintly glow when you heal a creature.
You can use the {@item staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and while you are holding it you gain a +3 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your Healer spells.
In addition, whenever you roll a number that is equal to this {@item staff|XPHB}'s +3 bonus or lower on a Healer's Die, you can re-roll the die and must use the new roll.

itemGroup.name: Asclepius Staff
entries: This fine {@item wooden staff|XPHB} is decorated with reliefs of snakes twisting along its shaft, which faintly glow when you heal a creature.

You can use the {@item staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and while you are holding it you gain a bonus to the saving throw DCs of your Healer spells. This bonus is determined by the {@item staff|XPHB}'s rarity.
In addition, whenever you roll a number that is equal to this {@item staff|XPHB}'s bonus or lower on a Healer's Die , you can re-roll the die and must use the new roll.
